prompt: Override equals, hashCode and toString on ShipmentKey so a HashMap can find a parcel from an equal-but-different key. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Object.equals compares references, so without an override two separately built keys with the same data are different keys and a HashMap lookup misses. A hash-based collection first picks a bucket from hashCode and only then calls equals, which is why equal objects MUST return equal hash codes -- otherwise the map looks in the wrong bucket and never finds the match. Because equals here ignores carrier case, hashCode has to ignore it too, hence hashing carrier.toLowerCase().
hints: Start equals with the two cheap cases: return true for this == other, and false when other is not an instance of ShipmentKey.
instanceof already returns false for null, so you do not need a separate null test.
Objects.hash(carrier.toLowerCase(), trackingNumber) builds a hash from exactly the same information equals compares.
